tasks.instruction: Fix witnessed stale TDA rule-search request handling. New query or clear must invalidate old responses immediately before debounce expires. Only newest request may update results/error/loading; clearing must remain empty and idle even after old completions. Catch thrown transport, show generic Japanese recoverable search error without raw backend detail, and permit subsequent query recovery. Keep rule/quiz content and DB unchanged. Protected browser acceptance covers five real TSX scenarios using synthetic deferred transport and must remain unchanged. Resolve pinned npm dependencies from trusted external parent node_modules, cache in owned OS temp, no installs or cache inside prepared source worktree. No commit/push by worker; controller validates/commits.
